programme.title: The Smurfs S1 - Chef Soup Adventures in Smurfsitting
programme.desc: When Brainy criticizes Chef's cooking, Chef walks out in a huff and ends up cooking for the Ogres. When Clumsy and Dimwitty take care of Baby, they try to show all of Smurf Village how smurfsome they really are.

programme.title: The Casagrandes S3 - Sidekickin' Chicken Silent Fight
programme.desc: After hearing about a contest to find El Falcon's next sidekick, Carl becomes El Pollito and tries to win! Once Carlitos falls asleep, Carl and CJ must conduct all their playing - and fighting - in absolute silence!

programme.title: The Casagrandes S3 - Kick Some Bot Salvador Doggy
programme.desc: Sid faces off against Lisa Loud in the Great Lakes City robotics competition! When faced with a deadline and no inspiration, Frida tries to use Lalo's paintings as her own!

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show S1 - The Uncredible Journey Host-a-Palooza
programme.desc: Tinkle, Ouchie, and Pinkeye must venture back home together after being taken away by mistake. Patrick gets injured, so his family members take turns hosting the show.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S14 - Snow Yellow
programme.desc: When Snow Yellow is deemed the "Squarest of them all", the evil Queen Karen seeks to claim the title for herself by any means necessary.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S14 - SpongeBob & Sandy's Country Christmas
programme.desc: When one of Sandy's experiments goes awry, the Cheeks family team up to save Christmas in Bikini Bottom.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S13 - SpongeBob on Parade
programme.desc: The Krusty Krab enters a float in the annual Bikini Bottom Parade.

programme.title: The Thundermans: Undercover S2 - The Most Thunderful Time of the Year
programme.desc: Phoebe and Max tell holiday stories to compete in the Thundermans Story Slam, but it's Chloe's story that makes them understand the meaning of the holiday.

programme.title: Danger Force S2 - A Henry Among Us
programme.desc: After Volt and ShoutOut are kidnapped by Cyborg Rick Twitler, Henry Hart returns from Dystopia in an attempt to save his friends and stop the anti-internet cyborg for good.

programme.title: Henry Danger S1 - The Bucket Trap
programme.desc: Henry and Charlotte want to tell Jasper that Henry is really Kid Danger. They decide to give Jasper a test secret to prove he's ready.

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles S2 - Get Rod
programme.desc: No one likes Rod, especially the Turtles! Bishop's former intern keeps trying to kidnap them and steal their mutant blood, but when Rod himself is kidnapped... Mikey is on the case! His first suspect: the mutant-hating Mechazoid maker BISHOP.

programme.title: Wylde Pak S1 - Meats of Strength Dead Ed's
programme.desc: Jack's new friend Beef invites him to a sleepover. Jack, a sleepover newb, freaks out over impressing his new friend. Jack &amp; Lil try to prove they're the one true local, enduring a series of bizarre quests in the local dive restaurant Dead Ed's.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S14 - PL-1413 In the Mood to Feud
programme.desc: Plankton travels two thousand years into the future and finds a few unfamiliar faces. SpongeBob, Patrick, and Sandy find themselves in the middle of a long-standing feud between the Narwhals and the Planktons.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S14 - Mooned! Hysterical History
programme.desc: SpongeBob wants to catch an ultra-rare jellyfish and enlists the help of former jellyfishing champion, Kevin. On a trip to the museum, SpongeBob and Patrick teach Sandy all about Bikini Bottom's fascinating, yet questionable, history.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S14 - The Dirty Bubble Bass Sheldon SquarePants
programme.desc: Bubble Bass and the Dirty Bubble team up to become Bikini Bottom's nastiest nefarious nuisance. Plankton joins the SquarePants family in the hope of becoming closer to SpongeBob (and the secret formula).

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S9 - Squid Baby
programme.desc: Squidward hits his head and reverts to being a baby, and it's up to SpongeBob and Patrick to take care of him.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show S3 - Patrickle Jokes Pat Roast
programme.desc: Patrick and Squidina go undercover to investigate a corrupt novelty product factory. The Patrick Show presents the "Roast of Patrick Star".

programme.title: The Casagrandes S1 - Guess Who's Shopping for Dinner? New Roomie
programme.desc: Abuela teaches Ronnie Anne that getting ingredients for dinner is no small task. When Vito's apartment floods, the kids try to find an apartment that suits him best.

programme.title: The Casagrandes S1 - Mexican Makeover Uptown Funk
programme.desc: Adelaide and Carl have an adventure on Mr. Chang's route, but can they work together to save the day? When Mama Lupe comes to visit, Abuela tries to get her family at the top of their cultural game.

programme.title: The Casagrandes S2 - Zoo-mergency!
programme.desc: After a zoo fundraiser goes wrong, Sid must save the day with her family!

programme.title: The Casagrandes S2 - Just Be Coo Tee'd Off
programme.desc: When Sancho gets himself into trouble in the city, Sergio helps him become a model pet! Worried that Lori may have a new crush, Bobby visits her in college and tries to impress her with his golf skills.

programme.title: Wylde Pak S1 - Where There's a Will, There's a Way Lost in the Sauce
programme.desc: When the house AC breaks during an extreme heat wave, Will takes it upon himself to protect his family and fix it. Ellie insists on running Raven Club like a dictatorship, so Jack &amp; Lil quit, and Ellie must save her investigation AND best friends.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show S1 - Nitwit Neighborhood News The Patrick Show MidSeason Finale
programme.desc: Patrick and Squidina report the news around Bikini Bottom. The Patrick Show presents the epic conclusion to the first half of its first season.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S9 - Squid Plus One The Executive Treatment
programme.desc: After receiving an invitation to a gallery opening, Squidward scrambles to find a friend to take with him. While trying to order a special sandwich, Patrick gets swept up in the fast paced world of business.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S9 - Company Picnic Pull Up a Barrel
programme.desc: Mr. Krabs throws a company picnic to boost morale, but Plankton is hosting his own on the same day! Mr. Krabs regales SpongeBob with tales from his old Navy days.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S11 - Spin the Bottle
programme.desc: Plankton poses as a wish-granting genie in his latest scheme to get the secret formula.

programme.title: The Casagrandes S2 - No Egrets Meal Ticket
programme.desc: Ronnie Anne and Sid help Casey run his family food truck... at the Yoon Kwon concert! Sergio is in for a treat when a group of baby birds think he's their mama!

programme.title: The Casagrandes S2 - Fool's Gold Flight Plan
programme.desc: When they find a treasure map, the Casagrandes go on a wild search for Pancho Villa's gold. Frida and Carlos go on a fancy plane ride, but Carl and CJ try to sneak on for an adventure of their own.

programme.title: Wylde Pak S1 - Journey to the Otter Side
programme.desc: The family's excited to take Jack to Lake World, Lily's favorite theme park. But when a lackluster day ends with realizing Lily's favorite ride has vanished, the kids must survive a thrilling adventure to find it and save their vacation.

programme.title: The Casagrandes S2 - I, Breakfast Bot Dynamic Do-Over
programme.desc: Ronnie Anne and her cousins hatch a plan to have Sid's Breakfast Bot do their chores - ALL of them! When Carl's dreams are crushed after meeting El Falcon, Bobby decides to take on the role himself!

programme.title: Danger Force S2 - A Henry Among Us
programme.desc: After Volt and ShoutOut are kidnapped by Cyborg Rick Twitler, Henry Hart returns from Dystopia in an attempt to save his friends and stop the anti-internet cyborg for good.

programme.title: Danger Force S2 - Dude, Where's My Man Buggy?
programme.desc: When Danger Force borrows Ray's beloved Man Buggy without permission it falls into the hands of criminals Stupid Jeff and The Toddler. Now the team must track it down and get it back before Ray finds out.

programme.title: The Thundermans: Undercover S2 - Love is in the Lair
programme.desc: Mrs. Wong visits Secret Shores, and threatens to reveal the Thundermans' superhero identities to the town. But Max and Phoebe's plan to have Dr. Colosso keep her quiet backfires in ways they could not have imagined.

programme.title: Henry Danger S3 - Swellview's Got Talent
programme.desc: After discovering contestants on Swellview's Got Talent are losing consciousness, Captain Man and Kid Danger enlist the help of Charlotte and Schwoz in order to find out what is causing the mischief.

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles S2 - The Unusual Suspects
programme.desc: With some loose Mutagen at stake, Mikey questions Rod's siblings, the notorious and eccentric MAUDE and TODD... both of whom are trying to get their hands on some mutant blood as well. Can Mikey find Rod before it's too late?

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles S2 - The Big Muck
programme.desc: Who kidnapped Rod? Where is the mutagen? Why is Rod's family so weird? Everything has led to a confrontation of Rod's dad... but even with Rod's help, can Mikey and his brothers defeat the mutant known as MUCKMAN?

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S12 - FarmerBob Gary & Spot
programme.desc: SpongeBob and Patrick work a day on Old Man Jenkins' farm, much to his dismay. Sandy narrates the nocturnal adventures of Gary and his secret pal - Spot.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S12 - The Nitwitting The Ballad of Filthy Muck
programme.desc: Patrick inducts SpongeBob into his prestigious society of dullards and doofuses. Patrick takes his grime to a new extreme, playing around in so much trash that he becomes unrecognizable.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S11 - Goons on the Moon
programme.desc: Sandy takes her "Science Scout" troop on a trip to the moon. In space, no one can hear you NYAH-NYAH-NYAH-NYAH!

programme.title: The Casagrandes S3 - The Golden Curse

programme.title: Gods Of Honour - EP27
programme.desc: NAR JAR (CHAN HO MAN, BENNY) was a ‘Fire master’ in his previous life. He was killed by LEE CHING (YUEN WAH). After reincarnation, he ironically becomes CHING’s third son. He is very much affected by his old memories and cannot forgive his father. CHING also keeps his distance from him because of his exotic nature and eventually sends him away with excuses. Luckily, he is saved by some kind people and becomes a General when he is still a teenager.

programme.title: Madam Cutie On Duty - EP16
programme.desc: FA PING (Priscilla Wong), who was often made fun of by the others for being ugly during her childhood, underwent cosmetic surgery in the wake of an accident. Ever since then, she has been firmly convinced that an attractive appearance has a significant impact on one's life, and remains the same after joining the police.

programme.title: I've Got The Power - EP12
programme.desc: Chung Hau-nin (Ruco Chan), Kiu Yeuk-lam (Natalie Tong) and Ko Yung (Joel Chan) are complete strangers. After surviving a traffic accident, they astonishingly gain mystical power!_x000D__x000D_Hau-nin and Ding Shuk-man (Moon Lau) are a loving young married couple. programme.desc: General LI (TONG, MICHAEL) of the Chor Kingdom and wizard CHAI (CHAN HO, MOSES) were colleagues under the same mentor. programme.title: At The Threshold Of An Era - EP36
programme.desc: The property giant YIP WING TIM (Lo Ka Leung, Gallen) was born in the 60’s in Hong Kong. His father, honest and righteous, was betrayed by his brother and put into prison. With the help from his best friend MA CHI KEUNG (Kwok Chun On), TIM took over an incomplete village housing development.
